name: Elastic Diffuser Swept Volumetric Display
aliases: FlexiVol Swept Volumetric Display with Elastic Diffuser
definition: A swept volumetric display that replaces the rigid optical diffuser with an array of elastic strips, enabling users to reach inside the display volume for direct interaction with true-3D content.
summary: The Elastic Diffuser Swept Volumetric Display is a reach-through volumetric display that replaces rigid screens with elastic strips, enabling direct haptic interaction without global volume distortion.
